[[File:Kyle Krueger 2022 World Championship.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Kyle Krueger at the [[2022 World Championship]].]]
'''Kyle Krueger''' (DeckTech handle '''Meto''', GEMP handle '''JustShy''')<ref name="roster">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]]; [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit Google Sheet]; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing 8 October 2026]</ref><ref name="dt-26173">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/26173 It's a Kyle deck], DeckTech (Kyle "Meto" Krueger, 8 November 2002)</ref> is a member of [[Team 5]]<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021</ref>. He finished '''#7''' at the [[2022 World Championship]].<ref name="pc" /> Krueger also finished '''#26''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 32; Challonge seed 26).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref> He posted a [[Dark]] [[Tatooine: Desert Landing Site]] list on DeckTech (''the beast on the beach v2'').<ref name="dt-24467">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24467 the beast on the beach v2], DeckTech (Kyle "Meto" Krueger, 18 July 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24467/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24467/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009052233/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24467/ Wayback Machine].</ref> He also posted an earlier [[Dark]] [[Tatooine: Desert Landing Site]] list on DeckTech (''The Beast on the Beach'').<ref name="dt-24104">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24104 The Beast on the Beach], DeckTech (Kyle "Meto" Krueger, 24 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24104/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24104/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009064140/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24104/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
